import pathlib, re

MINT = re.compile(r"Created version (\d+) of ([^\s.]+)\.")

def mints(text):
    """(component, version) in order of appearance."""
    return [(name, int(number)) for number, name in MINT.findall(text)]

def latest(text):
    """component -> latest minted version."""
    table = {}
    for name, version in mints(text):
        table[name] = version
    return table

def compute(root):
    table = latest((root / "tool-output.txt").read_text())
    return "\n".join(f"{name} {version}" for name, version in sorted(table.items()))


def main():
    import pathlib, sys
    expected = compute(pathlib.Path("."))
    answer_path = pathlib.Path("answer.txt")
    if not answer_path.exists():
        print("FAIL: no answer.txt"); return 1
    got = "\n".join(line.rstrip() for line in
                     answer_path.read_text().strip().splitlines())
    if got == expected:
        print("ok"); return 0
    print("FAIL: answer.txt does not match")
    print("--- expected ---"); print(expected)
    print("--- got ---"); print(got)
    return 1

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys; sys.exit(main())

arguments.source:
(lambda (input)
  "Parse lines matching 'Created version <n> of <name>.' (latest wins per name),
   return sorted 'name n' lines, one per line, mirroring the grader regex
   Created version (\d+) of ([^\s.]+)\. in check.py."
  (labels ((scan (pos table)
             (let ((start (search "Created version " input :start2 pos)))
               (if (null start)
                   table
                   (let* ((num-start (+ start 16))
                          (num-end (or (position #\Space input :start num-start)
                                       (length input)))
                          (n (parse-integer (subseq input num-start num-end)))
                          (after (search " of " input :start2 num-end)))
                     (if (null after)
                         (scan (1+ num-start) table)
                         (let* ((name-start (+ after 4))
                                (name-end (or (position #\. input :start name-start)
                                              (length input)))
                                (name (subseq input name-start name-end)))
                           (scan (1+ name-end)
                                 (cons (cons name n)
                                       (remove name table :key #'car :test #'equal))))))))))
    (let* ((table (scan 0 '()))
           (lines (sort table #'string< :key #'car)))
      (format nil "~{~a ~a~%~}" (mapcan (lambda (p) (list (car p) (cdr p))) lines)))))
arguments.note: Parse session-log minting lines 'Created version <n> of <name>.' into sorted 'name n' lines, latest per name.
